summary: Scholar Rock Holding Corp filed an 8-K to disclose a prospectus supplement under its existing S-3ASR shelf, authorizing a new ATM offering of up to $200 million of common stock through Jefferies LLC. This replaces a prior November 2025 supplement and terminates that earlier offering. The company has already raised approximately $257.7 million net under the prior ATM program. The filing is a routine shelf takedown and capital-raising update, not a special-situations event such as an acquisition or strategic review. No deal terms, prices, or board recommendations are involved.
